description:
Pay 2 life to cast Rancor targeting any creature.
Defiler of Vigor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Spike Feeder to activate it, gaining 2 life.
Resolve Rancor.
Sacrifice Rancor to Gatherer of Graces.
Rancor triggers, returning to your hand.
Resolve the Gatherer of Graces ability, regenerating it.
Repeat.
